script: A blue whale's heart can weigh about 180 kilograms. Blue whales are the largest animals known to have ever lived, growing up to about 30 meters long. When one dives, its heart can slow to just 2 beats per minute. Yet this giant feeds mostly on krill, shrimp-like animals only a few centimeters long. An adult can eat several tonnes of krill in a single day. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
